airport_records.name: Carriacou – Lauriston (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Contemporary timetable names Carriacou. Bill Cameron first-person photographs and original opening programme place Lauriston opening in March1968. Use historical geographic name; no later honorary name or terminal configuration backdated. Coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not surveyed1986 terminal or runway positions. Later expansions are not reconstructed.

airport_records.name: Union Island – Clifton (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Contemporary1985 timetable establishes earlier Union Island service. Scott and Horrocks1993 UNEP CEP Technical Report27 section3.1 describes an existing airstrip being lengthened. The modern SVG Airport site lists opening1994; this does not date the first strip. Approximate Clifton airfield marker from modern reference, not a claim that the current extended/reclaimed runway existed in1986. Exact old runway alignment remains unverified. Coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not surveyed1986 terminal or runway positions. Later expansions are not reconstructed.

airport_records.name: Mustique (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Mustique Company history places construction/opening of Bamboo Airport under its1968 development entry. LIAT scan5 usesMQS; scan3 printsMSQ in the Mustique margin.
